The 5 second delay is actually good for the site. Seeing as Voat is getting a load more traffic from reddit, it is important to make sure that that traffic is genuine and not somebody trying to bring down the servers via a DDoS. So in terms of the stability of the site, at least at this stage, it's pretty much compulsory.

The minimum comment points to vote is to prevent vote manipulation. Without some sort of minimum anyone can just make new accounts and mass upvote their own submissions.

The check you're seeing is DDoS prevention. Voat has apparently been under DDoS attacks ever since people have been mass migrating, wouldn't be surprised if the DDoS is coming from butthurt reddit subs like SRS trying to protect their hugbox.
